title: SimulationConfig
description: Configuration schema for statistical significance simulation experiments.

dataset_id.description: OpenML dataset ID to use for the simulation.

missing_mechanism.description: The mechanism for generating missing data.

missing_rate.description: Proportion of data to make missing.

n_iterations.description: Number of simulation iterations to run.

imputation_method.description: Method used to handle missing data during analysis.

effect_size.description: Cohen's d for alternative hypothesis simulations (optional).
